title: hoa.2d.recomposer~
description: `hoa.2d.recomposer~` recomposes a 2D plane-wave decomposition into a circular harmonic representation, providing harmonic inputs and plane-wave outputs. Its initialization arguments specify the decomposition order, number of plane-wave channels (`0` selects automatic calculation), and recomposition mode; channel angles are set in radians with the `angles` message.
